##### Project general facts

7 Seasons is a contemporary residential address set within International City Phase 2, where modern architecture meets practical urban living. Designed as an intimate development of just 85 residences, the project offers a selection of studios, one-, and two-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully planned to maximize space, light, and everyday functionality. Clean architectural lines and a welcoming design approach create a sense of comfort and simplicity, making 7 Seasons an ideal choice for those seeking a balanced and well-connected lifestyle.

The development enhances daily living with a curated range of amenities designed for both relaxation and activity. Residents can stay active in a fully equipped gym, unwind by the swimming pool, or enjoy outdoor gatherings in the dedicated BBQ area. Families benefit from a safe and engaging children’s play zone, while the overall community atmosphere encourages connection and a vibrant, easygoing lifestyle within a well-established neighborhood.

Interiors at 7 Seasons feature modern finishing with high-quality materials, creating clean and functional living spaces that are both comfortable and durable. Equipped kitchens are designed for convenience and everyday use, seamlessly integrated into the layouts. Residences are offered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their interiors while enjoying a solid foundation of contemporary design and practicality.

##### Location description and benefits

International City Phase 2 in Dubai is an extension of the original International City, designed to offer a modern residential community with a focus on affordability and convenience. Located in the Al Warsan area, this phase continues the theme of diverse, globally inspired architecture, offering a variety of residential apartments within low-rise buildings. With improved infrastructure and amenities, International City Phase 2 appeals to young professionals, families, and expatriates seeking cost-effective housing with good connectivity to major areas of Dubai.

The community features a blend of residential and commercial spaces, with essential services such as supermarkets, retail outlets, and dining options within close proximity. International City Phase 2 is also known for its accessibility, with easy access to major highways like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Dubai-Al Ain Road, making it well-connected to other parts of the city. 

One of the highlights of International City Phase 2 is its focus on creating a balanced lifestyle, offering green spaces and parks for residents to enjoy. While being a budget-friendly alternative to some of Dubai's more upscale neighborhoods, the development maintains a community-centric design, with recreational facilities and open areas that promote a healthy and active lifestyle. This makes it an ideal choice for those seeking an affordable, yet well-equipped, community in Dubai.
